production_review.result: No additional production blocker found in reviewed rank paths; remaining visual acceptance is listed separately.
production_review.server_initialization: Initialized after building_system and building_upgrade_system. BUILDING_LIST_REQUEST with {} actually returns all owners' living, completed buildings; verified with the real request handler and two owners.
server_lifecycle: Generation guards invalidate earlier subscriptions on repeated init.
Unique nettable session invalidates stale replicated entries across restarts.
Publish deduplicates unchanged presentation state without entity scanning.
Death/removal events and one-second invalid-entity/post-game sweep write tombstones.
Owned entity handle check prevents a late ordinary death/removal event clearing a reused entity index.
client_recovery: Restores both map-shaped and key/value-array nettable snapshots.
A session arriving after unit records triggers snapshot restoration.
Missing child container retries rather than permanently stopping after XML hot reload.
Entities.IsDormant is optional: current Workshop build does not expose it.
Entities.GetHealthBarOffset is optional and exception guarded, with a 180-unit fallback.
Physical screen coordinates are converted using Panorama UI scale; viewport and shared HUD occlusion hide covered/offscreen ranks.
Per-entity errors hide that panel, frame errors hide all panels, and subsequent frames continue.
Hot reload stops the old schedule/listeners and deletes its panels before starting a new instance.

debug.reports: Session, state/panel/visible counts, hidden reasons, API availability, layout/occlusion, last exception and UR label text/visibility/measured dimensions.

production_review.manual_fixture_safety: Explicit Tools-only module, not loaded by production. Creates npc_survival_grid_preview_proxy, sets survival_is_building=false, does not publish BUILDING_CREATED or set survival_building_id. This excludes both name-based upgrade recovery and normal building recovery. Owns and cleans only its display units.
development_limitations: Calling only rank_service.init() manually in a live world restores ordinary towers from BUILDING_LIST, but an existing ultimate is not in that list. Production normal initialization and subsequent fusion events are supported; isolated server reinit after an existing ultimate needs republishing that ultimate.
Mock tests do not establish native font rendering, engine particle behavior or absence of engine crashes.

native_death_route.payload: Native entity_killed keys.entindex_killed -> payload.victim handle plus payload.victim_entindex; rank and effects subscribe to the same events.ENGINE_ENTITY_KILLED constant and read victim.
native_death_route.fallback: A rapidly removed non-building proxy can yield a nil/invalid victim handle; effect and rank lifecycle sweeps retire invalid entries at 0.5 s / 1 s.
native_death_route.normal_building: building_system additionally emits BUILDING_DESTROYED(public_state) for registered completed buildings. Normal G destruction retires state synchronously if native death delivery is deferred. The display fixture intentionally does not enter this gameplay registration path.

manual_fixture_death_assertion.workshop: PASS within the isolated display-fixture scope: root observed DEATH_FLAG true and DEATH_HANDLES false 0 around 2026-10-01 01:49. DEATH_FLAG is fixture.last_death_passed from the 1.25-second callback, which requires both untracked/zero effect handles and absent/removed rank replication. The deliberately killed slot 3 is absent in the final SSR capture. No normal paid upgrade transaction is claimed.

postmortem.initial_layout: Real tower_rank_ui.xml contains no Image or Label; display panels are instantiated only after a valid state and drawable world position, with parent visibility collapse before children are created.

postmortem.evidence_boundary: Compilation and simulations are recorded separately from Workshop screenshots. The old crash was not proven to have a unique Lua cause; this report makes no contrary claim.

manifest_baseline.decision: Per coordinating agent instruction, retain the payment_test XML entry as an explanatory comment to match the pre-existing running baseline. Do not delete payment code or enable the unfinished payment entry during this release.

Seven real routes across all 25 levels, selected names, unchanged rows, all-player recovery, lifecycle, deduplication and restarts.
Existing integration plus actual all-player list payload, event-driven R publication and selected-unit prefix despite stale cached name.

Explicit Tools guard, neutral display proxy, no building registration, ten models, late UR model preload, level switching, same-handle move, death/cleanup and no async resurrection. Corrected delayed death checks cover both sweep periods, do not query a removed entity, verify the rank tombstone, and are cancelled on cleanup.
